titulo_ventana: STAR FORGE - Space Mission Design Game

avatar.ayuda: Mix anything with anything: every option fits every body.

misiones.ayuda: Start with Easy to master the budget split. Each mission you complete unlocks the next one.

_nota_v2: Mission names, descriptions, resources, AION and credits come from interfaz/guia_misiones_en.json.

laboratorio.ayuda_mover: WASD: move  E: interact  H: ask AION  M: sound  Esc: pause

cml1.texto: Welcome, {nombre}! Go to the computer and confirm your mission.

cml2.texto: Good job, {nombre}! Now study the mission conditions.

cml3.texto: Visit each station and assign your resources. Use the clues in the archive.

cml4.texto: Go to the archive (purple !) for the budget review. Stations are still editable.

pistas.guardadas: Your clues are stored in the archive. Visit the green ! anytime to review them.

revision.ok: Costs are within the assigned budget.
revision.aviso_ok: Once you confirm the launch, you can't change your design.
revision.excedido: The total cost exceeds the assigned budget. Adjust your resources.

frases.despegue: T-3, 2, 1... Ignition! Engines at full thrust. Let's see if your numbers hold.
frases.explota: Structural alert! The launch loads were too much for the structure.
frases.no_llega: Engine cutoff too early! Not enough delta-v to reach the target.
frases.se_apaga: Batteries at zero! The spacecraft used more energy than its power system supplied.
frases.incomunicada: We made it... but our signal can't reach Earth!
frases.sin_ciencia: The spacecraft survived, but without enough science instruments it missed its objective.
frases.fuera_de_tiempo: The spacecraft ran out of endurance before the mission plan was complete.
frases.exito: Mission accomplished! You think like a real mission designer.

resultados.revelado_parcial: How close each resource was (exact numbers unlock with 5 stars)

titulos_falla.no_llega: The spacecraft didn't reach its destination
titulos_falla.se_apaga: The spacecraft ran out of power
titulos_falla.incomunicada: The spacecraft lost contact with Earth

titulos_falla.fuera_de_tiempo: The mission ran out of time

notificaciones.bienvenida: Here are the station's missions. Start with Easy to master the budget split. Each mission you complete unlocks a new real engineering challenge.
notificaciones.reintento: Don't give up, {nombre}! Check the hint for each resource and try again.
